rules: Prompt rules: (1) Write the prompt as a caption: cohesive English prose that describes the visible choices - subject and action, relevant appearance, setting, camera/framing, medium, lighting, materials, palette and mood - with spatial relations in words. Keep subjects, counts and relationships exact. Add detail where it makes the image more specific; there is no word budget, and the caption may run to several paragraphs. Avoid quality tags and notes about the process. Plain prose only, no coordinates or JSON. (2) Visible text: quote the exact words in their original language, including punctuation and line breaks, and write the intended copy, not a placeholder. (3) Say what is there, not what is absent: the image model takes no negative prompt and does not act on 'no ...' wording. Not 'no text on the sign' but 'a blank single-colour signboard'; not 'no gradients' but 'every shape is filled with one even colour'. (4) Text, tables and diagrams the user may want to edit go on the slide in pptcom, not in the image. (5) Regenerate an image at most once, and only for a wrong subject or wrong text.

size.description: Pixel size. 1360x768 wide 16:9 (hero, banner, background, illustrated diagram); 1184x880 4:3; 1024x1024 square (icons, side images); 880x1184 or 768x1360 tall. Default 1024x1024.
